subject: form#search-form button[type=submit]
goal: Search the encyclopedia from its landing page
rationale: The search submit button should be available in the initial viewport. Language selection is also prominent, so this contract does not require search to outrank it.

subject: main .gem-c-search__submit
goal: Find government information using the homepage search
rationale: The homepage search submit button should remain available without scrolling, including with the initial cookie banner. No consent choice is made.

subject: #submit
goal: Search Python documentation and website content
rationale: The header search GO button should be an enabled action above the fold. This checks availability, not whether it is the page's most prominent action.

subject: main [itemprop=name] a
goal: Identify the repository before reading its contextual About information
rationale: The repository name should carry more visual weight than an About sidebar heading. Any baseline suspicion is a heuristic disagreement to review, not proof of a GitHub defect.

subject: main h1
goal: Read the product headline before its contextual introductory text
rationale: The large product heading should dominate introductory copy. The controlled change makes the secondary copy into a large, fixed banner without changing its words.
